Set out the provisional parts (printed page 6)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 6
A planning tray, not a purchase or cutting release. Verify actual lumber sections, cabinet templates and
the accepted connection details first.
printed page 6
CONDITIONAL: quantities change with field measurements and connections
printed page 6
W1-S01...S12 — 12 dry 2×4 studs; 1 candidate spare — Heights field-fit
W2-S01...S05 — 5 dry 2×8 studs; 1 candidate spare — Member/connection held
W1-BLOCK — 25 dry 2×6 flat blocks; 4 boards pack, 1 allowance — Bay/rail/fastener held
PRACTICE — 1 separate dry 2×4×10 board — Loose exercise only
GYPSUM — 8 half-inch + 2 five-eighth-inch 4×10 sheets in R35 nest — EX1 patches excluded; edge supports
held
printed page 6
Important distinction: the old R27 … 2×4 W2 studs, 2×4 backing, drywall sheet map, nail count, screw
grid and pickup cart are not valid for this revision.
printed page 6
The drywall figure is a rectangular stock study before the EX1 opening, patch shapes, ceiling interface,
board selection, waste and inspected seam support. Do not order exact sheet or fastener counts from it.
Source family: r35-p06-parts.svg · printed page 6 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
